body:
I have replicated this in v4.3, v4.4 and v4.5.beta3.

Setting `sync_to_physics()` removes the lag but it is stated pretty clearly in documentation that `sync_to_physics()` should not be used in conjunction with `move_and_colide()`.

> Godot v4.5.beta3 - Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (nvidia; 570.169) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 15.52 GiB memory

Not sure its the same issue as https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/53435.
but if the landing position is off by a length of  1 tick (**distance=planform_speed⋅proccess_tick_delta**​) thats the bug. because velocity, and position on jump taken from the prev proccess_tick every time, and the every new landing will move the char back by 1 tick length

ps. I can not reproduce this behavior with a simple Character code. but this can be related
